title: Clinical Application of Non-invasive PGT-A
brief_summary: The study aims to investigate the difference of in vitro fertilization (IVF) outcomes among non-invasive PGT-A, PGT-A and combined non-invasive PGT-A and PGT-A.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infertile women who undergo IVF with PGT
* BMI:18\~30 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Primary ovarian insufficiency
* Congenital uterine anomaly
* Severe male infertility (azoospermia)
* One of the couples with chromosome abnormality
* Malignancy
